# App build targets deliberately NOT in a CI build matrix.
#
# The release publishes `releases/*`, i.e. everything the matrices built, so a
# target listed here ships no UF2 and users cannot flash it. That is a legitimate
# choice — an unverified board target in the matrix is a published, unverified
# release asset. What is not legitimate is making that choice silently, which is
# how 41 targets ended up unshippable without anyone deciding to.
#
# Format:  <make target>  # reason
# A reason is mandatory; tools/check_build_coverage.py rejects a bare target.
#
# Adding a target to a matrix means shipping it. Removing its line here without
# adding it to a matrix makes the check fail, which is the point.
#
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# SEEDED 2026-08-09 from the pre-existing state, so the check can be switched on
# without forcing 41 product decisions in one sitting. "no recorded decision"
# means exactly that: nobody chose to exclude it, it was simply never added.
# Triaging these — ship, or keep out and say why — is tracked in #212.
#
# "announced in CHANGELOG" marks the subset with a broken promise attached: the
# release notes describe these as shipped features. A changelog is append-only,
# so those claims are still on the page a user reads today.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# --- Documented as immature. The one group with a real, pre-existing reason:
# Makefile:256 and CHANGELOG.md:576 both say "excluded until more mature".
usb2loopy_kb2040                          # immature, excluded by long-standing decision
snes23do_rp2040zero                       # immature, excluded by long-standing decision

# --- Honestly caveated already: CHANGELOG 1.9.0 says "not yet in CI release
# builds", which is still true. The only entry that told the truth.
usb2n64_kb2040                            # announced in CHANGELOG, correctly caveated as not in CI

# --- Announced in CHANGELOG as shipped, never built.
usb2ami_rp2040zero                        # announced in CHANGELOG (2.1.0, community contribution by @thgill, PR #140)
usb2ami_xiao                              # announced in CHANGELOG (2.1.0, community contribution by @thgill, PR #140)
usb2ble_pico_w                            # announced in CHANGELOG (2.0.0)
usb2ble_pico2_w                           # announced in CHANGELOG (2.0.0)
usb2usb_feather_rp2040_max3421            # announced in CHANGELOG (2.0.0/2.1.0); only the nRF52840 MAX3421E target ships
usb2usb_feather_rp2040_usb_host_max3421   # announced in CHANGELOG (2.0.0/2.1.0) by name; only the nRF52840 MAX3421E target ships
n642dc_pico2_w                            # announced in CHANGELOG (2.0.0, "Pico 2 W"); n642dc_kb2040 ships
gc2eth_rp2040_eth                         # announced in CHANGELOG (2.1.0, experimental)
gc2eth_feather_usbhost                    # announced in CHANGELOG (2.1.0, experimental)
bt2loopy_pico_w                           # announced in CHANGELOG (bt2gc/bt2nuon/bt2loopy); the other two ship
nuon2usb_kb2040                           # announced in CHANGELOG
nuon2usb_pico_w                           # announced in CHANGELOG
nuonserial_kb2040                         # announced in CHANGELOG (Nuon homebrew polyface serial adapter)
wii2n64_pico                              # announced in CHANGELOG (wii2usb/wii2gc/wii2n64); the other two ship
mouthpad_pico_w                           # announced in CHANGELOG by name ("Builds: ...")
mouthpad_pico2_w                          # announced in CHANGELOG by name ("Builds: ...")
usb2usb_ogxm_pico                         # announced in CHANGELOG (OGX-Mini Pico hardware)
controller_btusb_feather_rp2040_usb_host  # announced in CHANGELOG by name (tri-state pins, USB host, OLED)
wifi2usb_pico_w                           # announced in CHANGELOG (JOCP WiFi controller input, Joypad iOS app)
wifi2usb_pico2_w                          # WiFi/JOCP sibling of an announced target

# --- Never added, never announced, no recorded decision.
gc2dc_kb2040                              # no recorded decision
gc2usb_feather_usbhost                    # no recorded decision
usb2neogeo_retrofrog                      # no recorded decision
n642nuon_aries64                          # no recorded decision
controller_macropad                       # no recorded decision
controller_btusb_alpakka_pico             # no recorded decision
controller_btusb_feather_rp2040           # no recorded decision
controller_btusb_fisherprice_v1_kb2040    # no recorded decision
controller_btusb_fisherprice_v2_kb2040    # no recorded decision
usb2usb_remapper_v7                       # no recorded decision
usb2usb_remapper_v7_a                     # no recorded decision
usb2usb_remapper_v7_b                     # no recorded decision

# --- ESP32-S3. The Feather board has four apps wired up in the Makefile and only
# controller_btusb reaches CI; bt2usb ships for the XIAO board only.
bt2usb_feather_esp32s3                    # no recorded decision; bt2usb ships for xiao_esp32s3 only
usb2usb_feather_esp32s3                   # no recorded decision
btusb2usb_feather_esp32s3                 # no recorded decision

# --- nRF52840.
mouthpad_aprbrother_nrf52840              # announced in CHANGELOG by name ("Builds: ...")
bt2usb_aprbrother_nrf52840                # no recorded decision
controller_btusb_seeed_xiao_nrf52840      # no recorded decision; the Feather variant ships, the XIAO one does not

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# CMake executables (src/CMakeLists.txt) that no Makefile APP_/CONSOLE_ pair
# builds. Same end state as the targets above — no UF2 — reached from the other
# side: these have no make target at all, so they are invisible to a check that
# starts from the Makefile. Added 2026-08-10.
#
joypad_flash_b_side                       # SWD flashing utility, not an adapter app; never a release artifact
joypad_gc2dc                              # real app (GameCube -> Dreamcast) with no make target; unshippable, same class as the 41 above. Needs a product call (#212)
joypad_gc2usb_rp2040zero                  # redundant: APP_gc2usb_rp2040zero builds the generic joypad_gc2usb, which already gets WS2812_PIN=16 from PICO_BOARD=waveshare_rp2040_zero. Dead duplicate, not a coverage gap

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Platform backends that build with their own build system (`cd <dir> && make`)
# instead of a top-level `build_app` recipe. They are invisible to every check
# above, which all start from the top-level Makefile — there is no make target
# for them to be missing from a matrix. Added 2026-08-11, when the CH32V307 port
# turned out to have been unnoticed since June for exactly that reason.
#
# esp/ and nrf/ are not listed here because build.yml has build-esp and build-nrf
# jobs; if either job were deleted, the check would demand a line here instead.
#
wch                                       # full CH32V307 usb2usb port (all output modes, host registry, router, CDC), on main since 2026-06-04, builds a standalone wch.elf that ships nowhere. Not merely unwired: needs WCH gcc 8.2.0, pinned because newer GCC miscompiles the USB timing code, which no stock runner has. Shipping it is a product call (#212)
gba/joypad                                # GBA multiboot payload, NOT a standalone artifact: its output is committed as src/native/host/gc/gba_payload.c and ships embedded inside gc2usb's UF2, so it already reaches users. Building it in CI would need devkitARM. Caveat: nothing checks the committed payload still matches this source
tools/sinput-verify                       # host-side SInput verification tool, not firmware; never a release artifact
